svg.title: Metrics Monitoring and Alerting Platform — End-to-End Architecture
svg.desc: Comprehensive architecture of an enterprise metrics monitoring and alerting system serving 100M DAU and 10M active metrics, showing dual pull/push collection, consistent-hash collector ring, Kafka ingestion buffer, Gorilla TSDB with double-delta timestamp and XOR float compression, tiered 7d/30d/1y retention, AlertManager deduplication/routing, and Grafana visualization.
svg.text: Metrics Monitoring & Alerting Platform Architecture (10M Metrics · 100M DAU)
Pull/Push Ingestion · Consistent-Hash Ring · Kafka Buffer · Gorilla Double-Delta TSDB · Multi-Tier Retention · AlertManager
• Zero data loss on TSDB restart
D = 0 encoded as single '0' bit (96% of scrapes)
HOT TIER · Local NVMe / RAM (7 Days)
1M spl/s × 1.37 B × 7d = ~828 GB raw (85% of queries hit <26h)
Flushes immutable 2-hour blocks to warm storage
Index caches partitioned by time & tenant
COLD TIER · Object Storage / S3 (1 Year)
1-year retention · Parquet columnar chunks in S3 / GCS
5. Grafana Visualization & Production Telemetry Operations (Read Path Separation)
• Grafana dashboard fleet with templated variables
• Real-time RED & USE panels (p99 latency, QPS, error %)
p95 latency < 500 ms on 7d raw · < 3s on 30d/1y rollups
• Heavy ad-hoc regex queries cannot starve write path
• AlertManager uses dedicated query replica / evaluator
Prevents blind alerting outages during incident triage
• Single click jumps from p99 latency spike to exact distributed trace
Zero cardinality explosion: user_id stays in traces, not metric labels
